journey.name: Payment Request Confirmation Controls
journey.description: Verifies that the amount and Swipe To Pay remain visible while the requester summary and confirmation details scroll on a compact screen with large text. Requires a linked requester and a payer funded for 1,753 sats plus fees. Configure the payer at 360 dp width and 1.3 font scale before opening Bitkit. This journey covers Android's confirmation layout; iOS has a separate layout.

actions.action: On the requester, send the payer contact a Payment Request for 1,753 sats with a multi-paragraph invoice note
On the payer, verify Payment Request confirmation (testTag "PaymentRequestConfirm") opens automatically
Verify the full 1,753-sat amount (testTag "ReviewAmount"), Show details and Swipe To Pay (testTag "GRAB") are visible without scrolling
Verify From and For remain reachable by scrolling the middle content (testTag "SendConfirmContent") if the requester summary does not fit
Scroll the middle confirmation content (testTag "SendConfirmContent") to the invoice note (testTag "PaymentRequestInvoiceNote")
Verify the full amount and Swipe To Pay remain visible in their original positions above the system navigation area
Scroll the details back to the top
Verify the full amount, Hide details and Swipe To Pay remain visible
Tap Hide details and verify the amount and Swipe To Pay remain visible
